english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who knows their stuff, especially in practical or subject-specific contexts.

examples.english: This repairman is really knowledgeable; he can tell what is wrong with an old camera at a glance.
examples.traditional: 呢個師傅好識嘢，部老相機有咩問題一睇就知。
